text: Real GDP growth is projected at 3 percent in 2024 compared to an earlier projection of 3.7 percent, and 4.3 percent in 2025. Year-on-year inflation is expected to hit 2.5 percent by end-2024. Downside risks include commodity price rebounds, climate change, and dampening global tourism demand. Considering the authorities' strong program implementation and policy commitments going forward, staff recommend completion of the third reviews of the EFF and RSF.
